meta.interpretation: Compare how pembrolizumab and nivolumab trials are distributed across clinical trial phases, as two cohorts grouped by phase.
assumptions: Restricted to interventional studies, since observational trials carry no phase.
No date window applied - all registered trials are included.
Trials registered as spanning two phases (e.g. Phase 1/Phase 2) are counted in both phase buckets.
Cohorts are not mutually exclusive: trials testing both drugs appear in each cohort.
Phase 'Not Applicable' trials are shown as a category; trials with no phase field are excluded.
meta.counting_semantics: A trial may report several values for trial phase, so it is counted once per value. Bucket values therefore sum to more than the number of trials.
